declarations.type:
∀
  (totalCollectedWeight faultWeightBudget cutWeight actualFaultWeight liveUpperBound selected belowActualWeight
    aboveLiveWeight : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.VotingWeight),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinWeightedAuthorityQuantile.WeightedCutWindow totalCollectedWeight
      faultWeightBudget cutWeight →
    belowActualWeight ≤ faultWeightBudget →
      aboveLiveWeight ≤ faultWeightBudget →
        (selected < actualFaultWeight → cutWeight ≤ belowActualWeight) →
          (liveUpperBound < selected → totalCollectedWeight < cutWeight + aboveLiveWeight) →
            actualFaultWeight ≤ selected ∧ selected ≤ liveUpperBound
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinWeightedAuthorityQuantile.weighted_cut_certificate_is_safe_and_live
